theater: 南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲戰線

battle.name: 俄格戰爭
battle.theater: 南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲戰線
battle.brief: 2008年8月7日至12日，喬治亞軍與南奧塞梯亞民兵在茨欣瓦利交火，俄軍以第58集團軍自洛奇通道攻入，五日內攻佔南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲。卡面的1840年法國雷管步槍正是其技術源流：定裝藥一步到位；2008年決定陣地生死的同樣是射程——從AK-74到122毫米榴砲，隊形就散了。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 這是一場俄羅斯聯邦與喬治亞之間的武裝衝突，2008年8月7日至12日爆發，主戰場在南奧塞梯亞的茨欣瓦利市區與周邊，隨後延伸至阿布哈茲的蘇呼米方向。俄方以北方高加索軍區為大本營，軍區司令為尼古拉·波爾久熱夫上將，具體作戰由第58集團軍負責，軍長是弗拉基米爾·赫里斯托夫中將；8月8日成立代號「中心」的作戰集群，投入第42近衛摩托步兵師、第19、第76與第98摩托步兵師、第104近衛空降師、第31獨立近衛摩托步兵旅、第45特種部隊旅、第34山地炮兵旅等單位，另有第29摩托步兵師在阿布哈茲方向推進，炮兵由2S1「薔薇」120毫米自行榴砲、152毫米自走砲與BM-21「冰雹」多管火箭炮組成，空中有Su-25T攻擊機、Mi-24武裝直升機與Su-24M殲轟機，情報與通訊由特種部隊負責先行滲透。喬治亞方由總統米哈伊爾·薩卡什維利坐鎮國家安全會議，國防部長大維·凱澤拉什維利負責軍令，參謀總長喬治·戈格利澤上將掌軍事行動，第4軍團（駐梯比里斯）當面向南奧塞梯亞，第5軍團（駐塞納基）與第6軍團（駐泰拉維）向北梯比里斯方向靠攏；南奧塞梯亞方向由民兵司令哈賈巴·耶溫率領地方武裝，阿布哈茲武裝則在俄軍掩護下沿海岸線反攻。俄羅斯把行動定性為「恢復南奧塞梯亞秩序」，喬治亞則指控俄方動用國家武裝力量侵略；歐盟與歐安組織當時都派有觀察員，但沒有維護的授權。
countriesEn: This was an armed conflict between the Russian Federation and Georgia, fought from 7 to 12 August 2008. The main theatre was the city of Tskhinvali and its approaches in South Ossetia, later extended towards Sukhumi in Abkhazia. On the Russian side the operational base was the North Caucasus Military District, commanded by Army General Nikolai Bordyuzhev, with the fighting carried out by the 58th Combined Arms Army under Colonel General Vladimir Khristov. On 8 August a grouping designated Centre was formed for the operation, drawing on the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Division, the 19th, 76th and 98th Motor Rifle Divisions, the 104th Guards Air Assault Division, the 31st Separate Guards Motor Rifle Brigade, the 45th Spetsnaz Brigade and the 34th Mountain Artillery Brigade, while the 29th Motor Rifle Division operated in the Abkhazia sector. The artillery arm consisted of 2S1 Gvozdika 120mm self-propelled howitzers, 152mm self-propelled guns and BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers, and the air arm flew Su-25T attack aircraft, Mi-24 attack helicopters and Su-24M fighter-bombers, with specialists and spetsnaz troops infiltrating ahead of the main body for reconnaissance. On the Georgian side, President Mikheil Saakashvili chaired the National Security Council, Defence Minister David Kezerashvili issued the operational orders and General Giorgi Goglidze, Chief of the General Staff, ran the military planning; the 4th Army Corps at Tbilisi faced South Ossetia directly, while the 5th Corps at Senaki and the 6th Corps at Telavi moved north towards the Georgian capital. The South Ossetian militia was led by Khajaba Eving, and the Abkhaz forces counter-attacked along the coast under Russian cover. Moscow framed the operation as the restoration of order in South Ossetia, while Tbilisi accused Moscow of using the state armed forces for aggression; the European Union and the OSCE both had observers deployed, but neither had a mandate to intervene.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩個層次。第一層是政治層：喬治亞總統薩卡什維利在7月推動以「恢復憲法秩序」為名的攻勢，8月7日當晚批准軍方重新奪回茨欣瓦利；俄羅斯總統德米特里·梅德維杰夫、總理弗拉基米爾·普京與國防部長謝爾蓋·紹伊古在8日拍板出兵，普京當晚公開表示不會對南奧塞梯亞的局勢袖手旁觀，國防部則以北高加索軍區為主體策劃了這場行動。第二層是軍事指揮層：北方高加索軍區司令波爾久熱夫上將負責戰區，第58集團軍軍長赫里斯托夫中將直接指揮前線，摩托步兵師師長與炮兵旅指揮官層層下達命令；喬治亞方面則由國防部長凱澤拉什維利、參謀總長戈格利澤上將與前線旅、營級指揮官執行命令。南奧塞梯亞民兵首腦哈賈巴·耶溫、阿布哈茲武裝首腦以及在北奧塞梯亞與車臣招募的志願兵首領在局勢轉折時掌握地方武裝的動向。兩起被廣泛記錄的空難牽涉其中：8月8日，喬治亞駐俄軍事專員尤里·薩維列夫上校及副官維切斯拉夫·扎瓦德內中校，乘坐俄軍米-8直升機在茨欣瓦利上空被喬治亞地空導彈擊落而陣亡；8月26日停火前夕，喬治亞米-8與俄軍米-8在同一天分別被對方防空系統擊落，各有九名軍人死亡。志願兵方面，「格羅莫夫上校之翼」的謝爾蓋·格羅莫夫與車臣「高加索」旅的杜卡·烏馬羅夫也在作戰序列之內，說明這場衝突並非單純的政府軍對決。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sat at two levels. The first was political: Georgian President Saakashvili pushed an offensive justified as the restoration of constitutional order through July, and on the evening of 7 August authorised the army to retake Tskhinvali. Russian President Dmitry Medvedev, Prime Minister Vladimir Putin and Defence Minister Sergei Shoigu took the decision to intervene on 8 August, with Putin stating publicly that Moscow would not stand aside over South Ossetia, and the Defence Ministry planning the operation around the North Caucasus Military District. The second level was the command chain: Army General Nikolai Bordyuzhev ran the theatre as the district commander, Colonel General Vladimir Khristov commanded the 58th Combined Arms Army at the front, and motor rifle division commanders and artillery brigade commanders issued orders down the line. On the Georgian side, Defence Minister Kezerashvili, Chief of the General Staff General Goglidze and the brigade and battalion commanders carried out the orders; Khajaba Eving led the South Ossetian militia, the Abkhaz leadership commanded the separatist forces, and volunteer leaders from North Ossetia and Chechnya controlled the local irregulars at the turning point. Two well-documented air crashes involve senior figures: on 8 August Colonel Yuri Saveliev, the Georgian military attaché in Russia, and his aide Lieutenant Colonel Vyacheslav Zavadny were killed when the Russian Mi-8 helicopter carrying them was shot down by Georgian air defences over the Tskhinvali sector; on 26 August, the closing day, a Georgian Mi-8 and a Russian Mi-8 were each shot down by the opposing side, with nine servicemen killed in each case. The volunteers mattered too: Sergei Gromov, who led the Wings of Colonel Gromov, and Dokka Umarov of the Chechen Kavkaz brigade were part of the order of battle, which shows this was not a clean contest between two regular armies.
kits: 卡面這件1840年的法國雷管步槍，技術源頭在於底火取代火燧之後首次真正做到的「一體化定裝藥」：底火、發藥與彈頭合成一枚可重複裝填的整體，紙殼或金屬藥筒讓裝填速度與一致性大幅提升，射程隨之延伸、命中率隨之提高。它在本役並非一件實物，而是三個半世紀後的子彈口徑標準：俄軍的7.62×39毫米步槍彈（AK-74M、PKM通用機槍、SVD狙擊步槍）與5.45×39毫米步槍彈（AK-105、AN-94），以及喬治亞軍同樣大量裝備的AK-74與RPK，正是這條由雷管步槍與金屬藥筒鋪出的技術路線的末端。真正決定陣地生死的火力來自砲兵：122毫米與130毫米榴砲、152毫米自走砲、BM-21「冰雹」多管火箭炮對茨欣瓦利市區實施密集直射，單是10日早晨對市區的炮擊就持續約二十分鐘。步兵支援裝備包括RPG-7、AGS-17自動榴彈發射器、2S1「薔薇」自行榴砲，以及T-72坦克與BMP-2步兵戰鬥車；喬治亞方面的火力骨幹是122毫米D-30牽引榴砲與少量120毫米自行榴砲，裝甲同樣是T-72系列。防空與制空方面，俄軍以9K33「薩姆」S-300地空導彈壓制喬治亞的S-125與S-200系統，喬治亞航空兵則出動Su-25T與Su-24M。運輸與補給靠數百輛汽車經洛奇公路與隧道送入，裝甲運兵車BTR-80與BMP系列負責前線擺渡。
kitsEn: The card's 1840 French percussion rifle matters because it delivered, for the first time, a truly one-piece cartridge: the primer, the propellant and the bullet combined into a single charge that could be loaded and fired repeatedly, whether on paper or on brass. That raised the rate of fire, the consistency and the effective range of the infantry arm. It is not present on the battlefield of 2008, but its descendant is: the 7.62x39mm cartridge used by the Russian AK-74M, PKM general machine gun and SVD sniper rifle, the 5.45x39mm cartridge used by the AK-105 and AN-94, and the AK-74 and RPK held in large numbers by the Georgian army all sit at the end of the same technical line that began with the percussion rifle and the metal cartridge case. The firepower that actually decided the fate of positions came from the artillery: 122mm and 130mm howitzers, 152mm self-propelled guns and BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers were used in dense direct fire against the city of Tskhinvali, with the bombardment of the morning of 10 August lasting roughly twenty minutes. Supporting infantry weapons included the RPG-7 and the AGS-17 automatic grenade launcher, mounted alongside T-72 tanks and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles; the Georgian artillery backbone was the 122mm D-30 towed howitzer with a small number of 120mm self-propelled guns, and their armour was likewise T-72 based. In the air-defence and air-superiority contest, the Russians used 9K33 Osa S-300 systems to suppress the Georgian S-125 and S-200 batteries, while Georgian aviation flew Su-25T and Su-24M. Logistically, several hundred trucks fed the front through the Roki road and tunnel, with BTR-80 armoured personnel carriers and the BMP series ferrying the infantry shuttle-fashion up the approaches.
tactics: 喬治亞軍的戰術是以既有行政區為依據的線性據點防守：第4軍團所屬部隊與南奧塞梯亞民兵在阿夫涅維（Avnevi）方向、埃雷德維（Eredvi）口袋地帶及通往茨欣瓦利的公路上反覆爭奪，步兵依托村鎮、樹線與土壘配置，炮兵以122毫米牽引榴砲支援，但因制空權與偵察能力盡失，火力準備普遍不足，陣地縱深也沒有拉開。俄軍採用的是高節奏的機械化作戰：先以偵察分隊與特種部隊滲透奪取路口，再以摩托步兵師沿洛奇公路至茨欣瓦利這條唯一幹線高速縱深推進，裝甲步兵擔任先鋒，炮兵以營為單位隨進展開，Su-25T與Mi-24在低空提供火力支援，BM-21火箭炮對縱深與道路樞紐實施齊射，9K33防空系統同時壓制對方制空。10日清晨對茨欣瓦利市區的密集炮擊是全役最關鍵的一次火力準備，它摧毀了市區內的指揮節點、通信設施與彈藥庫存，使喬治亞守軍在縱深不明的狀態下被逐出市區。俄軍沒有採取大迂迴，幾乎沿公路直線壓進，這種打法換來速度，卻留下沿線補給與側翼薄弱的弱點；阿布哈茲方向同樣靠一條海岸公路推進至蘇呼米。最終停火線大致沿祖加姆（Zugdami）、加利（Gali）與蘇呼米外圍劃定。
tacticsEn: Georgia fought as a linear defence anchored to existing administrative lines. Units of the 4th Army Corps and the South Ossetian militia fought back and forth around the Avnevi sector, the Eredvi pocket and the road to Tskhinvali; the infantry manned village strongpoints, tree lines and fieldworks, with 122mm towed howitzers in support, but with air superiority and reconnaissance stripped away, fire preparation was generally thin and the defensive depth was never pushed back. The Russians ran a high-tempo mechanised operation. Reconnaissance detachments and spetsnaz units infiltrated and seized junctions first, then motor rifle divisions advanced at speed along the single trunk route from the Roki road to Tskhinvali, with armoured infantry as spearhead, artillery firing in battalion packs and moving up with the advance, Su-25T and Mi-24 aircraft providing close air support, BM-21 rocket launchers saturating the depth and the road hubs, and 9K33 batteries suppressing the opposing air defences at the same time. The bombardment of the Tskhinvali town centre on the morning of 10 August was the decisive fire preparation of the whole war: it destroyed command nodes, communications and ammunition stocks inside the city and pushed the Georgian garrison out of Tskhinvali without knowing the depth of the position in front of it. The Russians made no large envelopment, pressing almost straight along the roads; the method bought speed but left the flanks and the line of supply thin. The Abkhazia axis advanced in the same way, along a single coastal road as far as Sukhumi. The eventual ceasefire line ran roughly through Zugdami, Gali and the approaches to Sukhumi.
data: 本役的數字在各方說法之間差距很大，只能取有出處的量級。時間上，2008年8月7日夜至12日為大規模交火期，前線主要戰鬥約五天，至16日南奧塞梯亞方向仍有零星槍聲，8月26日俄喬總統會晤後停火機制才固定下來。兵力上，喬治亞國防部估計俄軍在南奧塞梯亞境內的總兵力在數千人至一萬人之間，編制為一個集團軍級集群；喬治亞投入南奧塞梯亞方向的部隊估計不足兩千人，第4、第5、第6軍團合計可用兵力遠高於此但未及投入，砲兵與車輛分散在各營。傷亡方面，俄方公布第58集團軍共有474人傷亡、其中174人陣亡；喬治亞國防部公布陣亡228人、受傷約1,370人；南奧塞梯亞民兵與各地志願兵另有數百人傷亡，數字未經統一核對。戰後多方統計雙方合計陣亡人數落在1,000至1,700之間，各方說法並存。距離上，洛奇隧道口至茨欣瓦利約70公里，阿布哈茲海岸線推進全程約100公里，側翼迂迴則被地形與時間排除。物資上，10日對市區的一次炮擊即耗用數百發大口徑炮彈，彈藥存量吃緊迫使俄方在2010年後大幅擴充122與152毫米炮彈生產線，並自2012年起自斯洛伐克等國進口152毫米炮彈以補足庫存。
dataEn: The figures for this war differ sharply between the parties, so only figures with a documented source can be given, and only as orders of magnitude. On timing: the main fighting ran from the night of 7 to 12 August 2008, about five days in all, with sporadic exchanges in the South Ossetian sector continuing until 16 August, and the ceasefire mechanism only settling after the Russian and Georgian presidents met on 26 August. On strength: Georgian estimates put the total Russian force inside South Ossetia anywhere from several thousand men to ten thousand, organised as one army-level grouping; the Georgian troops committed to the South Ossetian axis are estimated at fewer than two thousand, though the 4th, 5th and 6th Corps together had far more available and never brought them to bear, with artillery and vehicles dispersed battalion by battalion. On casualties: the Russian side reported 474 killed and wounded in the 58th Army, of whom 174 were killed; Georgia's Ministry of Defence reported 228 dead and about 1,370 wounded; the South Ossetian militia and the various volunteer units added several hundred casualties, uncounted and unverified. Post-war compilations place total deaths on both sides between 1,000 and 1,700, with the accounts incompatible. On distance: it is roughly 70 kilometres from the Roki tunnel mouth to Tskhinvali, and about 100 kilometres along the coast in Abkhazia, with flanking movement ruled out by terrain and by time. On materiel: the single bombardment of the town on 10 August consumed several hundred large-calibre shells, and the resulting strain on ammunition stocks pushed Russia, after 2010, to expand its 122mm and 152mm shell production lines and to import 152mm shells from Slovakia and elsewhere from 2012 onwards.
cause: 遠因是1991至1992年喬治亞境內多族群衝突留下的未了債務。南奧塞梯亞於1991年宣布脫離格魯吉亞，1992年喬治亞武裝在茨欣瓦利實施大規模攻擊，之後雙方停火，形成「南奧塞梯亞武裝民兵」與喬治亞第4軍團長期對峙的灰色地帶；1992至1993年的阿布哈茲戰爭則迫使喬治亞放棄該區，此後兩地實際由分離武裝控制。中近因是2003年玫瑰革命後薩卡什維利政府以「恢復憲法統一」為綱的整體政策：加入北約、推進巴庫—第比利斯—傑伊漢輸油管、清除境內分離武裝；與此同時俄羅斯以烏克蘭天然氣糾紛、管道走向與車臣問題向格魯吉亞持續施壓，2007年北約慕尼黑外長會議前雙方關係已公開惡化。直接導火線出現在2008年8月6日夜至7日晨：喬治亞軍炮擊阿夫涅維方向並攻入埃雷德維口袋地帶，茨欣瓦利市區與周邊隨即交火，南奧塞梯亞民兵向俄羅斯求援，7日俄方高層公開表態，8日俄軍越境。北約在1999年科索沃的介入先例，以及2004年別斯蘭人質事件之後俄羅斯形成的干預慣性，讓雙方都預設了最壞情境並各自備手。
causeEn: The remote cause lies in the unsettled multi-ethnic conflicts of 1991 to 1992 inside Georgia. South Ossetia declared separation in 1991, Georgian forces attacked Tskhinvali on a large scale in 1992, and the ceasefire that followed left a grey zone in which the South Ossetian armed militia and the Georgian 4th Army Corps faced one another for a decade. The Abkhazia war of 1992 to 1993 forced Georgia to abandon that region altogether, and from then on the two territories were effectively held by separatist armed groups. The proximate cause lies in the policies of the Saakashvili government that took office after the Rose Revolution of 2003, all under the banner of restoring constitutional unity: joining NATO, pushing the Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline, and clearing separatist armed formations out of the country. At the same time Russia pressed Georgia through the Ukrainian gas dispute, the question of pipeline routes and the Chechen issue, and the relations between the two countries had openly soured before the NATO foreign ministers' meeting in Munich in 2007. The immediate trigger came during the night of 6 and the morning of 7 August 2008, when Georgian artillery fired towards Avnevi and Georgian troops entered the Eredvi pocket; fighting broke out around Tskhinvali, the South Ossetian militia appealed to Russia for help, Russian leaders commented publicly on 7 August, and Russian troops crossed the border on 8 August. The precedent of NATO's action in Kosovo in 1999 and the Russian habit of intervention formed after the Beslan hostage crisis in 2004 meant that both sides assumed the worst and prepared accordingly.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了2008年之後的歐洲安全格局，也改變了武器市場的方向。俄羅斯於8月26日承認南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲獨立，格魯吉亞實質失去這兩地；歐盟隨即中止與俄羅斯的夥伴關係與合作協約，歐洲安全合作在歐安組織框架內停滯，而格魯吉亞被夾在歐盟東方夥伴關係與北約路線之間。俄羅斯同年的新版軍事學說（2008年12月）把美國列為主要威脅，並於2009年退出《歐洲常備軍力條約》，國際規則主導權的鬆動由此加速。對軍備而言，2008年之後俄羅斯明顯加強精確導引砲兵、遠程火箭炮與防空反器材的補充，並在2012年後大量進口152毫米炮彈，之後在2014年與2022年的烏克蘭衝突中再度使用「先建立作戰集群再快速推進」的同一套作法，其源頭都可追到南奧塞梯亞的經驗。對格魯吉亞而言，軍隊完成一次大規模實戰改裝，裝備與編制為加入北約做了一次徹底整理，但同時承受被迫接受分離主義現實的代價，總統薩卡什維利於同年11月宣布辭職，翌年1月舉行提前選舉。歐洲的能源安全格局亦受牽動，高加索管道與黑海走廊的重要性被重新評估。
impactEn: The war reshaped European security after 2008 and redirected the arms market. On 26 August Russia recognised South Ossetia and Abkhazia as independent states, and Georgia effectively lost both territories. The European Union suspended its Partnership and Cooperation Agreement with Russia, European security cooperation inside the OSCE framework stalled, and Georgia was left stranded between the EU's Eastern Partnership and its NATO aspiration. Russia's new military doctrine of December 2008 named the United States as the principal threat, and in 2009 Russia withdrew from the CFE Treaty, accelerating the loosening of the international rules-based order. As far as armament is concerned, after 2008 Russia visibly reinforced its stocks of precision-guided artillery, long-range rocket systems and anti-materiel defences, and from 2012 onwards imported 152mm shells in bulk; the same doctrine of raising a consolidated operational grouping first and then advancing rapidly was applied again in the 2014 and 2022 conflicts over Ukraine, and its lineage runs straight back to the experience of South Ossetia. For Georgia, the campaign forced a comprehensive modernisation of the army, with equipment and organisation thoroughly reshaped in preparation for NATO membership, but it also carried the price of accepting the reality of separatism: President Saakashvili resigned in November of the same year and a snap election was held in January. European energy security was affected as well, with the South Caucasus pipeline and the Black Sea corridor reassessed in importance.
result: 結果是俄羅斯完勝、喬治亞的攻勢全面崩解。俄軍在8月10日進入茨欣瓦利，8月12日佔領蘇呼米，並與阿布哈茲武裝控制阿布哈茲全境，喬治亞政府軍撤回察卡什維利（Chakvi）與哥里一線的縱深地帶，丟棄大量火炮、汽車與彈藥。8月12日達成的停火條件包括喬治亞軍隊撤出南奧塞梯亞、解除武裝並不得進入阿布哈茲方向；8月26日梅德維杰夫與薩卡什維利在莫斯科會晤後再簽協議，把停火線與雙方駐紮區固定下來，並成立聯合委員會監督。俄軍其後於10月自茨欣瓦利市中心撤出，但保留市郊基地與通往俄羅斯的通道，2009年4月亦撤走南奧塞梯亞境內的彈藥庫設施，軍事存在並未消失。南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲自此處於分離政權的實際控制之下，格魯吉亞的主權只及於其餘國土，這條分界線此後二十年間基本維持原狀。戰役在軍事上五天結束，在政治上卻拉長成二十年的僵局，並成為2014年克里米亞與其後俄烏衝突的前奏。
resultEn: The result was a complete Russian victory and the total collapse of the Georgian offensive. Russian troops entered Tskhinvali on 10 August and occupied Sukhumi on 12 August, working with the Abkhaz forces to take control of all of Abkhazia, while the Georgian government forces withdrew to the depth behind the line of Chakvi and Gori, abandoning large quantities of guns, vehicles and ammunition. The terms agreed on 12 August required the Georgian army to withdraw from South Ossetia, to disarm and to stay out of the Abkhazia sector; on 26 August, after Medvedev and Saakashvili met in Moscow, a further agreement fixed the ceasefire line and the zones of troop presence on both sides and created a joint commission to supervise it. The Russians later withdrew from the centre of Tskhinvali in October but kept a base on the outskirts of the city and the corridor back towards Russia, and in April 2009 they even removed the ammunition depot inside South Ossetia, without the military presence disappearing. South Ossetia and Abkhazia have since remained under the actual control of separatist governments, and Georgian sovereignty now extends only to the rest of the country; that dividing line has stayed essentially where it was drawn for two decades. The campaign ended in five days on the field, and was stretched into a twenty-year political stalemate, and it became the prelude to Crimea in 2014 and to the later Russian-Ukrainian war.
